heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Can you build a multi-restaurant marketplace?
items.answer: Yes. Multi-vendor support with commissions and separate restaurant dashboards is available.

items.question: Is real-time tracking included?
items.answer: Yes. Customers can follow riders live on the map.

items.question: Can I add grocery or other deliveries?
items.answer: Yes. The platform can support additional categories.

items.question: How long does food delivery app development take?
items.answer: A launch-ready first version takes 8 to 12 weeks, while a full platform with customer, provider and admin apps takes 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
